description: Normalise Arabic text so that forms users type interchangeably compare equal — strips diacritics and tatweel and folds the alef variants. Use it for search keys, deduplication and matching, never for text you are about to display.

convertDigits.description: Convert Arabic-Indic digits into 0-9. Default false.

unifyAlefMaqsura.description: Fold ى into ي. Helps fuzzy matching, changes meaning. Default false.

unifyTaaMarbuta.description: Fold ة into ه. Helps fuzzy matching, changes meaning. Default false.

name: normalize_arabic
